qualifier: NK and NKT cell activation and expansion
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling driving NK and NKT cell expansion
rationale: All members concern IL-15/IL-21 common-gamma-chain signaling and the NK/NKT cell activation, differentiation and proliferation it drives, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12/IL-23, IL-2/IL-7 or NF-kB myeloid activation without the NKT-specific terms.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs with FLT3-CBL-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine RUNX-family target-gene regulation in hematopoietic and other lineages with FLT3 receptor signaling, its CBL/SRC regulation and STAT5 activation; RUNX-only confusables lack the FLT3 arm and FLT3/interleukin confusables lack the RUNX arm.

name: TGF-beta-SMAD regulation of fibroblast fibrotic remodeling
rationale: Members span TGF-beta receptor/SMAD2/3 signaling and its feedback, plus myofibroblast, collagen, matrix assembly and connective-tissue replacement outputs; confusables share the fibroblast/matrix side but lack the core TGF-beta/SMAD terms (having cardiac muscle, MMP/elastin, or miRNA processing instead).

qualifier: ryanodine receptor control of striated muscle contraction
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release regulating striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern release of sequestered calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels and its control of cardiac and skeletal contraction, relaxation and rate, whereas confusables emphasize SERCA calcium reuptake, ATPase regulation and positive inotropy/chronotropy.

core: B cell migration and lymphoid organ development
name: S1P receptor-guided B cell positioning and lymph node development
rationale: Members link S1P receptor signaling and migration receptors to B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone B cell differentiation and lymph node development, distinct from confusables built on CXCR4, T cell/dendritic chemotaxis or gut-associated lymphoid tissue.

name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and selective cargo targeting
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and deliver cargo (mitochondria, microbes, synaptic proteins) to autophagosomes, whereas confusables focus on lysosome/endosome fusion or reticulophagy and nucleophagy.

name: Cardiac action potential phases 0-3 and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover depolarization, plateau and repolarization of atrial, ventricular and AV-node myocytes plus His-Purkinje signaling, distinct from confusables centred on potassium channels and phase 4 resting potential or SA-node pacemaking and gap-junction coupling.

name: Cardiolipin and phosphatidylglycerol synthesis and remodeling
rationale: All members are the CDP-diacylglycerol to phosphatidylglycerol to cardiolipin route and cardiolipin remodeling, while confusables cover phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidic acid and acylglycerol metabolism.

name: Thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are thiamine (B1) and riboflavin (B2) metabolism and membrane transport, distinguishing the theme from cobalamin, pantothenate/CoA and carnitine/choline confusables.

qualifier: trans-Golgi network to endosome and lysosome
name: Trans-Golgi network-endosome-lysosome vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members describe bidirectional TGN-endosome transport, lysosomal protein targeting and TGN vesicle biogenesis feeding secretion, whereas confusables center on COPI Golgi-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic or Golgi retention.

name: PPAR-gamma-driven white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: Members cover PPAR-gamma signaling regulation, white fat cell differentiation and proliferation and fat pad development, unlike confusables centred on LXR lipid genes, PGC-1alpha/circadian programs or thermogenesis.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme-to-epithelium transition in nephron tubule formation
rationale: Members concern metanephric mesenchymal progenitor maintenance, differentiation and MET into tubule epithelium, distinct from confusables on S-shaped body morphogenesis, ureteric bud/nephric duct or kidney size control.

name: Endosomal trafficking and internalization of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors
rationale: Members concern endosome-based recycling, internalization and membrane localization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors with supporting actin and synaptic membrane recycling, whereas confusables cover presynaptic active-zone structure, BDNF/TrkB signaling or AMPA receptor clustering and plasticity.

name: Glycerophospholipid and acylglycerol catabolism generating endocannabinoid signals
rationale: Members are phospholipase/lipase breakdown of lysophospholipids, PC, ether lipids, PAF, DAG and MAG yielding arachidonate and N-acylethanolamine/endocannabinoid signals, distinct from confusables on acyl-chain remodeling, phospholipid synthesis and glycerol metabolism.

core: Placental and early embryonic lineage development
name: Early embryonic lineage specification and trophoblast-driven placental development
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm/ICM and germ-cell specification and trophoblast proliferation, migration, giant-cell differentiation, labyrinth and decidual development, unlike confusables on gonad, mammary gland or germline stem cells.

name: Addictive drug responses and reward-based conditioning
rationale: Members are cellular and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine and opiate-type alkaloids, DARPP-32 signaling and operant/place-preference learning, whereas confusables cover dopamine receptor signaling, neuropeptides or other innate behaviors.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members combine prefoldin-CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin with CCT-dependent telomerase holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and telomere extension; confusables have generic folding/refolding or rRNA modification without both arms.

qualifier: inhibitory control of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation
name: Myeloid inflammatory activation and inhibitory checkpoints on phagocytosis
rationale: Members cover monocyte/DC/neutrophil inflammatory and defense activity together with SIRP-family and other negative regulation of phagocytosis, degranulation and neutrophil activation, whereas confusables emphasize respiratory burst, complement receptors, heme or TLR endogenous ligands.

name: Mitochondrial translation and respiratory complex assembly
rationale: Members are mitochondrial ribosome translation, inner-membrane insertion and assembly of complexes I, III, IV and ATP synthase, distinct from confusables on electron transport, chemiosmotic ATP synthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly.

core: Cellular cholesterol efflux and HDL formation
name: Macrophage cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell control
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly, reverse cholesterol transport, sterol homeostasis and foam cell formation, unlike confusables on lipoprotein remodeling/clearance, dietary lipid absorption or SREBP/LDL receptor uptake.

name: Thymic T cell selection and thymocyte development
rationale: Members are thymocyte selection, self-tolerance, migration, survival, proliferation and alpha-beta/gamma-delta differentiation in the thymus, distinguishing the theme from bone-marrow hematopoietic and B cell confusables.

qualifier: anterograde and retrograde IFT in cilium assembly
name: Anterograde and retrograde intraflagellar transport in ciliogenesis
rationale: All members are bidirectional intraflagellar transport supporting cilium assembly, distinct from confusables on basal body/centriole organization, ciliary cargo targeting or cilium disassembly.

qualifier: redox and nitric oxide synthase control
name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism in redox and NOS control
rationale: Members cover vitamin C and BH4 synthesis, transport and response with oxidoreductase/NOS activity and superoxide regulation, distinguished from confusables on xenobiotic response, iron homeostasis or general ROS detoxification and NADPH metabolism.

name: Muscle stem cell self-renewal and restraint of myogenic differentiation
rationale: Members concern satellite-cell maintenance and division, myoblast proliferation, migration and regenerative fusion and negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, whereas confusables promote myogenesis and fiber development or describe atrophy.

name: Ig-superfamily heterophilic adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are heterophilic adhesion via DSCAM, Sidekick and nectin/Necl immunoglobulin-superfamily proteins including dendrite self-avoidance, distinct from confusables on L1/NCAM, ephrin, netrin guidance or nodal neurofascin interactions.
